Subject: Reminder: Client Confidentiality Policy

Hi Team,

I wanted to take a moment to remind everyone about the importance of maintaining strict confidentiality regarding our clients.

Recently, it was brought to my attention that client details were shared inappropriately. Please remember that sharing any client information with anyone outside of the authorized team, including family members, is strictly against company policy.

Let’s all be vigilant in protecting our clients' data. If you have any questions about what constitutes sensitive information, please reach out to me.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
